summary: Add a way to look up scheduled jobs by the function they run (e.g. get_jobs_for(func)), with tests, so callers need not hold Job objects just to cancel them.
narrative: The owner asked for a function-based job lookup because they keep holding on to Job objects only to cancel them later. Memory so far shows only an exploration observation (#1) finding that the schedule library filters jobs by tag only, with no function lookup. No implementation, tests, PR or release is recorded yet.

milestones.text: Owner asked for a get_jobs_for(func)-style lookup of jobs by function, with tests.
Exploration found jobs can only be filtered by tag; no function-based lookup exists.
